messages:
lumen_poc_contact: Quick alert  during the demo today our Node client intermittently fails to parse SSE streams: partial JSON then socket closes. ~2x/min after a few KB.

zoe_sales: Hosted or Dedicated? Region?

lumen_poc_contact: Hosted, eu-west-1. Client shows `SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input`. No request-id. We saw a couple 429s from the edge.

carl_engineer: Can you paste a tiny curl capture and the client error?

lumen_poc_contact: curl snippet:
```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/abc"
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Content-Type: text/event-stream
< Transfer-Encoding: chunked
{ [1024 bytes]...
```
body sometimes ends like: `data: {"id":12,"text":"partial` then connection closes.

anya_infra: Proxy logs show `upstream_write() returned 0` and then `502 while reading upstream` at the same timestamps. Likely upstream closed or proxy reset. Two quick suspects: proxy buffering/idle timeout, or an internal token-bucket causing resets.

mike_support: Immediate mitigations: (1) disable proxy_buffering for route, (2) bump proxy_read_timeout/send_timeout to 180s, (3) advise client to buffer until SSE terminator (`\\n\\n`) before JSON.parse and use exponential reconnect on abrupt close/429.

carl_engineer: We'll also add per-stream `X-Request-Id` header in responses for tracing and an optional 15s heartbeat to keep proxies from closing idle streams.

anya_infra: Applying canary override for lumen org in eu-west now.

[~4m later]

anya_infra: Canary applied. Please retest.

lumen_poc_contact: Retest: 0 failures in 10 attempts so far. Running 2h soak and will report. Thanks for quick action.

tracebot: Created ticket SF-5077 to track request-id + heartbeat work, linked to lumen POC.

mike_support: ACTIONS: infra keep canary 48h and collect 502/5xx counts; eng add request-id + heartbeat toggle; solutions send polyfill snippet for robust SSE assembly.

lumen_poc_contact: Great, appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup:. Will update after soak.
